title: Las Vegas Businesses Ditch Credit Card Fees for Bitcoin Payments
summary: Las Vegas Valley businesses from juice bars to restaurant chains are adopting Bitcoin payments to eliminate credit card processing fees, leveraging Square's zero-fee Bitcoin acceptance program that runs through 2026 for approximately 4 million U.S. merchants.
